kb.title: Refunds for double charges and duplicate payments
kb.text: If a card is charged twice, open Billing, choose the duplicate payment and press Request refund. Refunds reach the card in 3 to 5 working days.

kb.title: Invoices, receipts and VAT numbers
kb.text: Add your VAT number under Billing, Company details. New invoices and receipts show it at once. Ask support to reissue older invoices.

kb.title: Locked account after a password reset
kb.text: After five failed sign in attempts the account locks for 30 minutes. Wait, then reset the password once and sign in with the new one.

kb.title: Two factor codes rejected
kb.text: Codes are rejected when the phone clock drifts. Turn on automatic time on the phone, then use a fresh code.

kb.title: CSV export errors and empty files
kb.text: Exports over 50,000 rows fail on the old exporter. Switch on the new exporter under Settings, Labs, then run the export again.

kb.title: Desktop app crash on start or in settings
kb.text: Clear the app cache folder and update to the latest release. If it still crashes, send the crash log from Help, Diagnostics.

kb.title: How feature requests and suggestions are handled
kb.text: We collect feature requests on the public roadmap board. Vote for an idea there; the product team reviews the top ideas each month.

kb.title: Slow dashboards, timeouts and lag
kb.text: Large dashboards load faster with fewer widgets per page. Turn on caching under Settings, Performance and avoid date ranges over a year.
